notes: `בְזָדוֹן` → *presumptuously* fuses under rule 30: one English word, and the preposition's noun keeps no word of its own.
`לְבִלְתִּי שְׁמֹעַ` divides as rule 48 directs — *in* to the preposition, *not* to the present negative substantive `בִלְתִּי`, *hearkening* to the infinitive.

The object marker at s019 takes the *before* through which *minister* reaches its object (rule 16's first family); the apodosis waw at s027 takes the *even*. The competing reading, giving that *even* to the marker, fails because the marker stands on the ministering clause and not on the fronted subject.
